config.description: One FRED API series/observations request per configured series, each over the full real-time window 1776-07-04..9999-12-31 so every ALFRED vintage comes back as [realtime_start, realtime_end] spans. Series are discovered and verified by build_config.py from FRED release 112 (State Employment and Unemployment); combinations here must match config.json (build_config.py --emit-combinations regenerates them). desired_bytes 320 MiB against a measured 0.28-0.46 MiB per series over ~600 series, i.e. ~0.17 GiB expected.

source.license_notes: FRED API Terms of Use (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/terms_of_use.html). The underlying series are US federal statistics (public domain); FRED terms govern API use. Cite FRED and BLS CES State and Area.
source.originating_source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics, State and Area (SAE)
source.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED/ALFRED)
